chunks: This is (indicated) in the Books of earlier people.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean when it says the Prophet's message is in the books of the earlier prophets?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'Zubur al-Awwalin' (Scrolls of the Ancients) is often interpreted to include the original, uncorrupted scriptures of previous prophets, affirming the continuity of Tawhid. This verse serves as a divine validation of the Prophet Muhammad's (peace be upon him and his family) message, countering the Meccan polytheists' claim that his revelation was novel or fabricated by linking it to the timeless tradition of the patriarchs and prophets.
